versions.content: Handling if Eth_MacSecAddRxSa is called and EthCtrlMac- SecEnabled of the addressed EthCtrlConfig is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If Eth_MacSecAddRxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthCtrlMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthCtrlConfig identified with the given CtrlIdx • a reception secure association can be added to the given association number (see An ), i.e. the given association number is not occupied then the Eth driver shall perform the following actions. Otherwise return with E_NOT_ OK : • create a reception secure association at the Ethernet controller that corresponds to the given CtrlIdx by considering the given association number (see An ), the lowest acceptable packet number (see LowestPn ), the short secure channel identifier (see Ssci ) and the secured association key (available via KeysPtr and addressed with SakKeyPtr ) • activate the created reception secure association, if given API parameter Active is set to TRUE , otherwise deactivate the created reception secure association • return with E_OK .
